interpretation.grasp_candidate: Closing command and at least one finger contacting a movable object starts a prospective five-frame window. Failed windows remain ambiguous even if a later window confirms.
interpretation.gripper_close: Existing raw extract_gripper_close_candidates transition/aperture rule; no old optional temporal smoothing/human-QA transfer. Initial +1 and failed transitions ambiguous.
interpretation.invalid_evidence: Reject entire malformed recording rather than infer negatives; a conservative superset of quarantining affected frames.
interpretation.numerics: Unchanged exact frozen threshold comparisons. Rotation evidence must be orthonormal proper matrices within 1e-8 absolute numerical tolerance.
interpretation.prompt_preview: All anchors diagnostic only, no event/source cap sampling or balance yet. Future contact/state/pose never exported as prediction features. Earliest event/tie priority unchanged.

permitted_application: Read only the three completed instrumented pilot numeric recordings; create unreviewed candidate diagnostics; no new recordings or production admission

covers: five-frame grasp confirmation and stationary continuation
SE3 frame invariance and SO3 wrap
future physical evidence excluded from preview input
